responsibility: Implements the full-width AVX-512 VPOPCNTDQ intrinsic header for per-lane popcount on 32-bit and 64-bit elements. It enables avx512vpopcntdq and exposes masked and unmasked wrappers for _mm512_popcnt_epi32 and _mm512_popcnt_epi64, serving as the 512-bit population-count interface distinct from the BITALG byte/word popcount header and the VL companion.
